title: The Comparison of Pulse Oximetry, End-tidal Capnometry, and Integrated Pulmonary Index (IPI)
brief_summary: To compare two ways to test breathing after surgery in acute care setting. One method tests oxygen level of the blood, and one method will test oxygen and the carbon dioxide that is breathed out.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Age greater than 18
* Increased Body Mass Index (BMI) \> 31
* History of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
* History of Sleep Apnea

Exclusion criteria:

* Respiratory failure
* Isolation requirements
* Surgical patients admitted to 2 West or ICU
study_population: Convenience sample post-operative in-patients admitted to 2 East at Allenmore Hospital/multicare Health system a 75 bed community facility.
